speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help us understand the cause of your chronic cough, weight loss, and weakness, have you experienced any recent fevers, night sweats, or coughing up blood?

speaker: Patient
text: 68-year-old male. The patient reports having a fever, cough, weakness, night sweats, and poor appetite persisting for 6 months. He has lost 7.5 kg (16.5 lb) over this period. No history of breathlessness, nasal discharge, nasal obstruction, palpitations, chest pain, or digestive symptoms. Released from prison 9 months ago after a 2-year sentence.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for that detailed history. Given your recent release from prison, we need to rule out tuberculosis, so I would like to know if you have had any close contact with someone who had TB while incarcerated, and do you currently smoke or have a history of smoking?
